parsed.summary: Critical syntax error prevents script from running; potential string formatting issue in logging statement.

findings.issue: Invalid f-string syntax in the print statement inside the main loop. The outer f-string uses single quotes while inner dictionary key accesses also use single quotes, causing premature termination of the string and a SyntaxError.
findings.evidence: Line: `print(f'{key}: base oos {sb['oos'].get('n')}/{sb['oos'].get('win')} b1 {r['b1'] and r['b1']['desc']} {r['b1'] and (r['b1']['oos'].get('n'), r['b1']['oos'].get('win'), r['b1']['oos'].get('mean'), r['b1']['p'])} {time.time() - t0:.0f}s', flush=True)`
findings.suggestion: Switch the outer f-string to double quotes or escape the inner single quotes. Example: `print(f"{key}: base oos {sb['oos'].get('n')}/{sb['oos'].get('win')} b1 {r['b1'] and r['b1']['desc']} {r['b1'] and (r['b1']['oos'].get('n'), r['b1']['oos'].get('win'), r['b1']['oos'].get('mean'), r['b1']['p'])} {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)`

parsed.coverage: The review covered all functional sections of the script, focusing on data handling, flag generation, statistical calculations, and output generation. No other runtime errors or logical inconsistencies were found.
parsed.limitations: The analysis assumes external modules (engine, quality, run825, scanner) behave as documented. Edge‑case behavior of those modules (e.g., empty trade sets) was not exhaustively tested here.
